look: Ashvein Hobgoblin, a D-rank GKOM variant from the Ashvein Goblinkin family: taller disciplined hobgoblin in mismatched scavenged plate with a round shield and short spear. Family anatomy: wiry olive-grey goblinoids with long pointed ears, black GKOM veins and ragged scavenged cloth. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystals crust its joints and run along the spine; about a quarter of the body crystallised; the crystals are smoky-grey quartz. A tennis-ball-sized GKOM core orb, dark amber with visible cracks, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, modest shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils
